svg.aria-label: Two architectures and a comparison table. SOA: web, mobile and enterprise apps call an enterprise service bus, which routes to customer, order, payment and notification services, each with its own database, and the order service calls the payment service through the bus. Microservices: web app, mobile app and API clients call an API gateway, which routes to customer, catalog, order and payment services, each with its own database, and the order and payment services call each other directly. The table compares communication, protocols, governance, service granularity, data ownership, reuse scope and what each is best for
svg.text: Through a central ESB in classical SOA;
Services call each other directly; the API
SOAP with WSDL contracts in classical SOA;
REST or gRPC in modern SOA

data only through the owning API
